source_analysis.skill: Solve first-order linear ODEs by integrating factors; identify an integrating factor and the general solution in two select fields.
reasoning_steps: Integrate IQ (directly or one integration by parts), then divide by I and retain C/I.
Select the corresponding entries from both full banks.
invariants: First-order linear equation and one arbitrary constant, not an initial-value problem.
Two select fields for question-bank instances; canonical example is worked prose without fields.
Positive-x domain for powers/logarithms from P=n/x.

Source RHS families: constants with P=n/x; scaled derivative/constant P and linear forcing; resonant polynomial-exponential; nonresonant exponential; reciprocal powers times exponential; reciprocal powers times sine/cosine requiring one integration by parts.
permitted_variations: Small coefficients and signs, derivative scaling and forcing amplitudes consistent with the observed integration workload.
P=n/x exponent, exponential rate and polynomial degree within simple observed scope.
Sine/cosine role, nonresonant exponent relationships, resonance when the same direct-integration method applies.
Distractor mathematical roles and ordering; which entry qualifies must follow the ODE, not a fixed label or position.
